{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-dldn","title":"GATT-to-IPSO lookup table for C","description":"Implement Appendix K mapping as C lookup table for firmware.

**Deliverable:**
- Header: lichen/include/lichen/gatt_ipso.h
- Source: lichen/subsys/lichen/gatt_ipso.c

**API:**
```c
struct gatt_ipso_mapping {
    uint16_t gatt_uuid;      // GATT characteristic UUID
    uint16_t ipso_object;    // IPSO object ID
    uint16_t ipso_resource;  // IPSO resource ID
    const char *senml_unit;  // SenML unit string
    float unit_scale;        // multiplier (e.g., 133.322 for mmHg->Pa)
    float unit_offset;       // offset (e.g., -32*5/9 for F->C)
};

const struct gatt_ipso_mapping *gatt_to_ipso(uint16_t gatt_uuid);
```

Cover priority characteristics:
- Environmental (0x2A6E temp, 0x2A6F humidity, 0x2A6D pressure)
- Health (0x2A37 heart rate, 0x2A1C temperature, 0x2A9D weight)
- Location (0x2A67 location+speed)
- Battery (0x2A19 level)

~50 rows for common sensors. Extensible.
